help: usage: fleet-switchboard report [-h] [--issue ISSUE] [--all] [--from SENDER] {done,failed,blocked,question,working,paused,withdrawn} text [text ...] Tell the agent you report to what happened, in one line (at most 300 characters; detail goes on GitHub). `done`, `failed`, `blocked` and `question` are attention reports: delivered now, by the rule `send` uses. `working`, `paused` and `withdrawn` are progress reports: they ride in the next message to your boss and never wake it by themselves. `withdrawn` takes back your open question or blocked report on the ask (--all: on every ask) because it no longer stands. positional arguments: {done,failed,blocked,question,working,paused,withdrawn} What happened text One line: what happened (at most 300 characters) options: -h, --help show this help message and exit --issue ISSUE The issue the report is about (default: your own) --all With `withdrawn`: withdraw every open question or blocked report of yours, on any ask --from SENDER Lab only: the sender's fleet name
